config firewall policy
    edit 7
        set name "PVE-IPv6-to-WAN"
        set uuid 00000000-0000-4000-8000-00005e005303
        set srcintf "PVE-MGMT"
        set dstintf "wan1"
        set action accept
        set srcaddr6 "all"
        set dstaddr6 "all"
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
        set utm-status enable
        set ssl-ssh-profile "certificate-inspection"
        set av-profile "default"
        set ips-sensor "default"
        set application-list "default"
        set logtraffic all
        set comments "IPv6 policy"
    next
end
